events.title: The army proclaims Diocletian Roman emperor
events.description: After Emperor Carus and his son Numerian died on campaign in Persia, the troops proclaimed the cavalry commander Diocles emperor as Diocletian. He defeated Carus's surviving son Carinus and later created the Tetrarchy.

events.title: Emperor Henry VI enters Palermo, capital of the Kingdom of Sicily
events.description: The Holy Roman Emperor Henry VI, meeting little resistance, entered Palermo, capital of the Kingdom of Sicily, which he claimed through his wife Constance. He was crowned king on 25 December, and the next day Constance gave birth to Frederick II.

events.title: Edward I is proclaimed king while returning from crusade
events.description: Four days after Henry III's death, his son Edward was proclaimed king though still abroad. Edward I conquered Wales, expelled England's Jews in 1290 and waged long wars against Scotland.
events.html: Four days after Henry III's death, his son Edward was proclaimed king though still abroad. Edward I conquered Wales, expelled England's Jews in 1290 and waged long wars against Scotland.

events.title: John the Fearless and Louis of Orléans swear a reconciliation
events.description: John, Duke of Berry, secured a vow of solemn reconciliation between his nephews, the rivals John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, and Louis I, Duke of Orléans. Three days later Louis was murdered in Paris on Burgundy's orders.

events.title: Hawke defeats the French fleet at Quiberon Bay
events.description: In a gale off Brittany, Admiral Edward Hawke pursued the French fleet among the rocks and shoals of Quiberon Bay and destroyed or scattered it. The victory ended French plans to invade Britain.
events.html: In a gale off Brittany, Admiral Edward Hawke pursued the French fleet among the rocks and shoals of Quiberon Bay and destroyed or scattered it. The victory ended French plans to invade Britain.

events.title: A sperm whale sinks the whaleship Essex
events.description: In the South Pacific, an enraged sperm whale rammed and sank the Nantucket whaleship Essex. Survivors spent about three months in open boats, resorting to cannibalism; the story inspired Moby-Dick.

events.title: British tanks attack in mass at Cambrai
events.description: Some 476 British tanks led a surprise attack at Cambrai, breaking through German lines several miles in a day. A German counter-attack soon recovered most of the ground, but the tactics pointed to the future.
events.html: Some 476 British tanks led a surprise attack at Cambrai, breaking through German lines several miles in a day. A German counter-attack soon recovered most of the ground, but the tactics pointed to the future.

events.title: The Nuremberg trials begin
events.description: The International Military Tribunal opened at Nuremberg to try 22 senior Nazi leaders for war crimes, crimes against peace and crimes against humanity. The trial laid foundations for international criminal law.
